race.description: Australia China Business Council Qld Hcp (Bm65)
race.comment: BEREZKA (4) missed by a whisker first-up at Eagle Farm then tackled a good Class 3 over this trip at Doomben last time and wasn't disgraced. Placed at seven of eleven runs over this distance. Has a tricky draw but with even luck can grab an overdue win. OUR HUNTRESS (12) made it two wins in a row when she led from the outset and just held on over 1350m at Ipswich recently. Very honest and is better placed back at 1200m. Can win again. LUMENS LENNY (5) backs up six days after leading but knocking up over this distance at Doomben. Can bounce back in this easier contest. MAQUISA (18) returns from a 101-day break. Raced exclusively south of the border last prep and was competitive at provincial and Sydney midweek level. Good enough to play a big role. SUPIDO'S CHOICE (15) scored convincingly on the poly track last start. Faces a stiffer assignment this time but cannot be ruled out.
